description: A dependency resolving to `.ts` source is ordinary in-program code, analyzed and enforced like your own files: its mark is honored, its unmarked body is read, and the manifest beside them is never consulted.

diagnostics.message: Call to `risky` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `risky` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
